text:
morgan: heads-up — we're shipping the "narrowcast" routing header in the API today; it's a small, structured hint clients can send to prefer a tenant-specific lane (low-latency vs low-cost) and cost attribution. want to align on SDK defaults + console telemetry before the rollout.
elaine: what does the header look like exactly? sample?
aj: example i proposed yesterday: `X-Redwood-Route: tenant=acme;mode=narrowcast;prio=5;pref=lowcost`  — very compact key=val pairs, semi-colon delimited. :eyes:
morgan: yep that's the one. also we added `attr` subfield for cost_center label: `attr=team:payments` so quota attribution can map to cost center in the console.
sam: are we sure we want free-form `attr`? that could explode labeling permutations and make dashboards noisy.
kris: +1 on restricting keys. proposal: whitelist `team`, `project`, `env` and reject/strip others at the edge. we can log raw attrs in audit-only mode for 30 days.
elaine: how will this affect SDKs? we need consistent header construction across py/ts/go or we'll break tests and attribution.
aj: plan: add a helper to each SDK `RouteHint` struct that validates/serializes. default behavior: SDKs do NOT set the header automatically — it's opt-in via `client.config.route_narrowcast(true)` to avoid accidental attribution changes.
morgan: opt-in default seems safe. but the console UX teams want a sample rate of 1% live traffic to show real examples in the new "Routing lanes" tile — can we add a telemetry flag in SDKs to enable sampling of header/response meta?
kris: implement `telemetry.route_hint_sampling=0.01` in SDK config. SDK will emit obfuscated route hint + hash for aggregation, not raw attrs, unless `devex-bot` opt-in env var is set for debugging.
sam: need to confirm privacy & PII: `attr=team` is ok, but project names could leak customer info. add validation to disallow spaces and `@`/`.` characters.
aj: will do. also adding a server-side shim: if header exceeds 256 bytes, drop `attr` portion and return `X-Redwood-Route-Accepted: trimmed` in response headers.
morgan: that response header will be useful for SDK logging and for console telemetry to mark trimmed requests.
deploy-bot: deploy started: route-narrowcast-edge  -> rollout canary 5% in region us-west-2
elaine: rollout plan: canary 5% for 24h, monitor `route_hint_trim_rate`, `quota_attribution_failures`, `route_lane_latency` on console. if any >1% error increase or >200ms p50 delta, rollback.
kris: console changes: new dashboard tile will show lanes (latency/cost per 10k tokens), and a pivot by `team` when available. we need a mapping from attr keys to readable names — propose a small admin mapping UI in settings.
sam: tests: add unit tests in each SDK for serialization/validation, integration test against staging edge that asserts trimmed header behavior and telemetry sampling. add e2e that checks console ingestion pipeline tags hashed attr key.
aj: go/py/ts diffs will be minimal: 1) add `RouteHint` type, 2) opt-in config flag, 3) sample telemetry emitter. i'll open PRs after edge canary goes.
morgan: communication: we should post deprecation-style note in release notes but call it "opt-in beta". send an email to partners asking them to opt-in for initial observations.
elaine: devex wants a migration doc snippet: how to construct header safely, how console attribution works, and fallback behavior. also include snippet for serverless env var to force sampling for local testing.
kris: one more thing — quota accounting: when `attr` present, quota should be charged to tenant-level buckets + cost-center mapping. we must ensure this doesn't double-count on proxy retries. edge will dedupe via `X-Redwood-Route-Id` UUID per request.
aj: adding `X-Redwood-Route-Id` in SDK helpers is trivial. make sure we keep it stable across retries inside the same SDK call.
morgan: OK actionable: aj open SDK PRs (py/ts/go) w/ opt-in flag + header helper + route-id; kris update console tile and admin mapping; devex write migration doc; ops monitor metrics during 24h canary. i'll post a brief note in #announcements after 1st-hour check. :shipit:
devex-bot: reminder — please add docs entry under /docs/routing/narrowcast and include sample curl, python, ts snippets.
sam: acked. i'll add test matrix to CI job to run SDK serialization tests.
morgan: thanks all — keeping this thread for rollout updates. ping here with any blocker. :ok_hand:
